decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 38 Dawes Avenue.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.30am  to 5.30pm  on Mondays to Friday and 8.30am  to 12.00 noon on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a double storey rear extension, because of the design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 38 Dawes Avenue and would be complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV B.1.1 (New development), H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, (2003) and Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Erection of a two-storey rear extension to the house
